description_raw: MIBiG record covers 37.168 kb, whereas the functional AFT programme appears broader
interpretation_raw: Treat reported BGC boundary and functional programme boundary as separate fields

description_raw: AF-toxin congener detection differs across studies
evidence_B_raw: YM-19 kinetic assay dominated by AF-toxin I
interpretation_raw: Preserve as potentially strain-, state-, or assay-dependent rather than forcing consensus

description_raw: The 2002 AFT1-1/AFT3-1 targeting experiment yielded toxin-minus mutants that had lost the entire 1.05-Mb accessory chromosome.
evidence_A_raw: targeted transformation was initiated at AFT1-1/AFT3-1
evidence_B_raw: all resulting toxin-minus/nonpathogenic mutants lacked the whole AFT chromosome
interpretation_raw: Treat this as strong chromosome-level causal evidence, not clean single-gene knockout evidence.

description_raw: MIBiG associates BGC0000004 with aflatoxin G1, but RIB40 is experimentally non-aflatoxigenic and its homologous cluster is inactive under tested conditions.
evidence_A_raw: MIBiG product field + independent G1 NMR evidence
interpretation_raw: Retain aflatoxin G1 as the database-linked product but score native RIB40 product formation as negative and native attribution as unproven.

description_raw: aflT transporter class differs between MIBiG and the primary paper.
interpretation_raw: Preserve both source annotations; do not silently harmonize without sequence-domain reanalysis.

description_raw: A deletion near norB/cypA is reported with different apparent extents across comparisons.
evidence_A_raw: ~1.5 kb deletion relative to A. parasiticus in Tominaga analysis
evidence_B_raw: later RIB40-type comparisons describe a smaller defined deletion interval
interpretation_raw: Treat as reference/alignment-dependent boundary description unless direct sequence reconciliation is performed.

description_raw: Multiple defects coexist in RIB40, so no single lesion has been shown to account for every level of nonproductivity.
interpretation_raw: Represent as a multilesion pathway; do not reduce to one 'silencing mechanism'.

description_raw: BGC0000005 is biologically well supported but the current MIBiG v3 repository marks the record retired.
interpretation_raw: Retain the record for historical/biological curation while preserving retired status; do not interpret retirement as evidence against the pathway.

description_raw: The 82,081-bp accession contains the historical ~70-kb 25-gene core plus four genes originally described as an adjacent sugar-utilization cluster, but later work demonstrated an aflatoxin role for nadA within that adjacent block.
evidence_B_raw: 2008 nadA disruption/expression/enzymology: nadA participates directly in G-group aflatoxin formation
interpretation_raw: Store historical core boundary separately from the evidence-updated functional programme boundary; do not classify nadA simply as non-BGC sugar-utilization.

description_raw: Historical aflJ nomenclature collides with standardized gene naming.
evidence_A_raw: Historical aflJ refers to the co-regulator now standardized as aflS
evidence_B_raw: Standardized aflJ refers to the estA locus
interpretation_raw: Store both standardized names and aliases explicitly; never merge aflS(old aflJ) with aflJ/estA.

description_raw: A partial duplicated cluster module exists in ATCC 56775 but is not a second complete functional pathway.
evidence_B_raw: Several duplicated structural genes carry damaging mutations/deletions and aflR2 cannot replace aflR1 in vivo
interpretation_raw: Represent as a partial/degenerated duplication relationship, not as an independent complete BGC.

description_raw: Later G-aflatoxin literature uses nadA nomenclature that can collide with historical consensus aflY/hypA naming.
evidence_B_raw: 2008 Ehrlich et al. describe the adjacent reductase as nadA and parenthetically use aflY terminology
interpretation_raw: Keep locus coordinates/protein accessions primary; never merge hypA/AAS66025.1 with nadA/AAS66029.1 solely on alias text.

description_raw: NCBI calls AY510451.1 the complete aflatoxin-cluster sequence, while AF13 lacks an intact ancestral norB–cypA G-branch module.
evidence_B_raw: Structural deletion removes promoter/5' coding regions for norB/cypA
interpretation_raw: Interpret 'complete sequence' as complete AF13 locus, not complete B/G functional repertoire.

description_raw: MIBiG marks BGC0000006 quality SQ_A and completeness unknown despite strong direct evidence for native B1/B2 production.
evidence_B_raw: Authentic-standard product evidence + extensive AF13 literature
interpretation_raw: Preserve MIBiG flags verbatim but score pathway identity and B1/B2 attribution independently as high.

description_raw: MIBiG records both B1 and B2, but the detailed cottonseed-reserve fermentation reported only B1 under its assay conditions.
interpretation_raw: Treat congener output as condition-dependent; do not force every experiment to show every validated pathway product.

description_raw: Two independent atfC mutants produced inconsistent aflatoxin phenotypes across liquid-stress and kernel assays.
evidence_B_raw: ΔatfC-2 reduced kernel aflatoxin while ΔatfC-1 remained near WT
interpretation_raw: Keep atfC as an uncertain/context-dependent modifier and preserve the contradictory mutant evidence.

description_raw: Historical aflatoxin-gene nomenclature creates an aflJ/aflS collision.
evidence_B_raw: Standardized nomenclature commonly uses aflS for that co-regulator and aflJ for historical estA
interpretation_raw: Store standardized names plus historical aliases explicitly; never merge the two loci.

description_raw: The 2004 cypA paper identifies AF13 as ATCC 96044 / SRRC 1273, whereas the current ATCC 96044 catalog describes the deposited product as an AF13 niaD− mutant derived from AF13.
evidence_B_raw: current ATCC catalog: strain designation AF13 niaD−; isolation source 'mutant derived from strain AF13'
interpretation_raw: Preserve AF13/SRRC 1273 as the biological strain identity used in the primary study; treat ATCC 96044 as a historically used/deposit alias with a current-catalog derivative caveat.

description_raw: MIBiG/GenBank-era records call BN008R Aspergillus flavus or an unnamed S_BG Aspergillus, whereas current taxonomy and isolate-specific sequence records assign BN008R to Aspergillus aflatoxiformans.
evidence_B_raw: NCBI Taxonomy TaxID 2059437 plus MK119715.1 = A. aflatoxiformans isolate BN008-R
interpretation_raw: Use A. aflatoxiformans as current organism identity while preserving the historical MIBiG/AY510452 label as provenance.

description_raw: BN008R toxin output changes by orders of magnitude with nitrogen source, but the molecular cause is not reducible to aflR alone.
evidence_B_raw: aflR often changes little; aflS/aflJ differs by strain group
interpretation_raw: Treat nitrogen as a context modifier/gate interaction rather than a single transcription-factor mechanism.

description_raw: Extreme pH effects on B1/G1 do not closely track aflR expression.
evidence_A_raw: Product strongly suppressed at low pH
evidence_B_raw: aflR correlation with AF yield r²=0.25
interpretation_raw: Retain as explicit evidence that downstream biochemical/physiological competence may dominate.

description_raw: cypA function is directly disrupted in A. parasiticus, while BN008R evidence is intact sequence + G-product phenotype.
evidence_B_raw: BN008R retains cypA and produces G1
interpretation_raw: Score BN008R cypA branch attribution high but distinguish direct from transferred mechanistic evidence.

description_raw: Published sources disagree on AF70 mating type.
evidence_A_raw: Gilbert et al. 2018 text states AF70 and NRRL3357 shared MAT1-1 sequence in the examined comparison
evidence_B_raw: Fountain et al. 2020 describes AF70 as MAT1-2
interpretation_raw: Do not encode a single mating type in scalar metadata until reconciled against the original marker/assembly data.

description_raw: MIBiG covers 75.8 kb and marks completeness unknown; the deleted proximal G-branch context is biologically explanatory but not represented as intact CDSs.
interpretation_raw: Store exact MIBiG boundary separately from functional ancestral pathway context.

description_raw: The 2018 EDNAtran proof-of-concept provides powerful matched toxin/transcript evidence but sequenced only one selected RNA library per treatment.
interpretation_raw: Use as strong descriptive evidence but not as a replicated differential-expression benchmark.

description_raw: fhpA deletion increased AFB1 but a functional complementation strain could not be generated.
interpretation_raw: Score as moderate causal evidence, below hbx1.

description_raw: Thousands of polymorphisms distinguish AF70 and NRRL3357 clusters, but specific variants responsible for the production difference are not established.
interpretation_raw: Preserve polymorphism burden as context, not as a deterministic causal explanation.

description_raw: MIBiG and historical papers use Aspergillus nomius; current NCBI and Index Fungorum use Aspergillus nomiae.
interpretation_raw: Use A. nomiae as the curated current orthography and retain A. nomius as the explicitly historical/database spelling.

description_raw: MIBiG length is 75,352 bp while FunBGCs reports 68,362 bp.
interpretation_raw: 68,362 bp exactly equals first-to-last CDS span; preserve both flanked and gene-span boundaries.

description_raw: MIBiG exposes only B1 and G1, whereas NRRL 13137 is documented as a B1/B2/G1/G2 producer.
evidence_B_raw: Strain literature = all four major congeners
interpretation_raw: Keep MIBiG product fields verbatim but encode the broader native product suite separately.

description_raw: cypA is directly disrupted in A. parasiticus, not in NRRL 13137.
interpretation_raw: Score G-branch attribution high but distinguish direct sequence/phenotype from transferred knockout mechanism.

description_raw: Temperature and transcript-before-product studies used other A. nomiae isolates, not NRRL 13137.
interpretation_raw: Use for transferable context hypotheses, not as direct measurements of BGC0000009/NRRL 13137.

description_raw: MIBiG lists generic aflatoxin and a compound structure, but AF36 is defined experimentally by failure to produce aflatoxin.
interpretation_raw: Interpret compound as pathway-family association only; native product formation = negative.

description_raw: MIBiG classifies the BGC as PKS but does not list a functional PKS CDS among the 22 genes.
evidence_B_raw: aflC/pksA sequence contains early stop codon and lacks functional protein accession
interpretation_raw: Add an explicit pseudogene row so loss of core enzymatic competence is machine-visible.

description_raw: 2016 comparative work places AF36 among genotypes retaining all standard cluster genes, while the MIBiG feature table has only 22 functional CDSs.
evidence_B_raw: MIBiG CDS table excludes pseudogenized pksA and the canonical A. flavus G-branch context is degenerate
interpretation_raw: Treat gene presence, intact CDS status and functional protein competence as separate variables.

description_raw: The pksA stop mutation is sufficient biochemically to explain atoxigenicity, but precise native-locus repair of AF36 was not the defining causal-rescue experiment.
evidence_B_raw: No direct repaired-AF36 rescue encoded here
interpretation_raw: Score gene-product attribution very high, but distinguish from gold-standard repair-and-rescue evidence.

description_raw: AF36 is biologically successful despite having a disabled aflatoxin pathway.
evidence_B_raw: Strong field fitness and competitive displacement
interpretation_raw: Do not interpret BGC nonfunction as organismal dysfunction; ecological fitness and pathway competence are separate layers.

description_raw: MIBiG assigns AF products to a 59.5-kb region that lacks canonical aflQ and aflP genes required for ST→AF conversion.
interpretation_raw: Treat MIBiG boundary as core cluster boundary, not complete functional programme boundary.

description_raw: A. ochraceoroseus produces aflatoxin but the canonical aflP/omtA ortholog is absent from the sequenced cluster and its functional genomic location is not resolved in the sources curated here.
evidence_A_raw: AF production requires late methyltransferase function
evidence_B_raw: Cluster lacks aflP; 2007 work initially failed to identify it by PCR/Northern
interpretation_raw: Mark aflP-equivalent as unresolved rather than assuming an ortholog location.

description_raw: ST and AF are both accumulated, but available evidence here does not establish whether ST accumulation reflects kinetic bottleneck, condition-specific regulation, enzyme efficiency, or export/recovery differences.
interpretation_raw: Preserve co-accumulation as observation without assigning a single mechanistic cause.

description_raw: The locus mixes aflatoxin (afl*) and A. nidulans sterigmatocystin (stc*) nomenclature because of its evolutionary/organizational relationship.
evidence_A_raw: MIBiG uses Afl and Stc product names
evidence_B_raw: Comparative literature maps homologous functions across systems
interpretation_raw: Preserve source names and add functional descriptions; do not force all genes into one nomenclature scheme.

description_raw: Later whole-genome resources often use A. ochraceoroseus IBT 24754, whereas BGC0000011 is from ex-type SRRC1432/CBS550.77.
evidence_B_raw: Modern genome studies may use IBT24754
interpretation_raw: Do not transfer genome coordinates or accessory findings between strain labels without verified strain equivalence.

description_raw: MIBiG associates the whole five-gene cluster with alternapyrone, while the defining experiment expressed only alt5.
interpretation_raw: Score Alt5→alternapyrone very high, but full-BGC→alternapyrone only moderate.

description_raw: The sources curated here do not demonstrate alternapyrone production by the native A. solani strain carrying AB120221.1.
evidence_B_raw: No matched native A. solani metabolite experiment in defining study
interpretation_raw: Mark native pathway state and recovery NR/UNCERTAIN rather than inferring natural production.

description_raw: Alt1–Alt4 are present and enzymatically plausible, but their exact A. solani reactions remain unresolved.
evidence_B_raw: Later homologous alt′ cluster functional data
interpretation_raw: Use later homologs only as transfer hypotheses, not direct gene-function assignments.

description_raw: Alternapyrone and derivatives have bioactivity, but no direct evidence establishes BGC0000012 as a virulence determinant of A. solani.
evidence_A_raw: A. solani is a necrotrophic pathogen
interpretation_raw: Do not encode pathogenic role without genetic or infection-stage evidence.

description_raw: Heterologous expression can be mistaken for activation of a silent native BGC.
evidence_A_raw: Alt5 product recovered after promoter-driven heterologous expression
evidence_B_raw: Native A. solani transcription/product state not tested
interpretation_raw: Treat as functional identification/bypass, not native activation evidence.

description_raw: Alternariol formation is demonstrated in engineered promoter-replacement strains, not clearly in unmodified FGSC A4.
evidence_B_raw: No matched wild-type native-production evidence in defining study
interpretation_raw: Store engineered activation and native pathway state separately.

description_raw: MIBiG displays 45,963 bp but identifies a 7,849-bp locus containing the two production genes.
interpretation_raw: Preserve both; do not treat all genes in the visual flank as demonstrated BGC members.

description_raw: Nearby putative TF induction failed, but this does not prove the TFs are biologically irrelevant.
evidence_A_raw: No product after engineered TF induction
interpretation_raw: Encode failed intervention as a negative result rather than a definitive regulatory knockout conclusion.

description_raw: MIBiG cites a 1953 Alternaria tenuis alternariol paper for compound evidence.
evidence_B_raw: A. nidulans biosynthetic attribution comes from 2012 engineered strains
interpretation_raw: Separate chemical-structure provenance from organism/BGC attribution.

description_raw: The defining discovery strains lacked sterigmatocystin production, which simplifies analytics but changes native metabolic competition.
interpretation_raw: Preserve the stc-deficient background as an experimental architecture variable when interpreting yield.

description_raw: PkgB co-induction greatly increases yield, but the exact proportion of its effect attributable to catalytic chain release versus broader stability/flux effects is not quantified.
evidence_A_raw: PkgA lacks release domain; PkgB is β-lactamase-type TE
interpretation_raw: Score release role very high but do not invent kinetic contribution.

description_raw: MIBiG exposes a 60,868-bp display region, a 41,240-bp locus feature and 11 CDSs, while deletion genetics supports a seven-gene functional programme.
interpretation_raw: Store all three representations; do not collapse them into one 'cluster length'.

description_raw: AN1030 is induced with the afo cluster during ScpR overexpression but its deletion does not change asperfuranone yield.
evidence_B_raw: Deletion argues it is dispensable for product
interpretation_raw: Represent as boundary-ambiguous/co-regulated passenger rather than required biosynthetic gene.

description_raw: The defining experiments establish engineered activation but do not identify the natural environmental signal that normally engages AfoA.
evidence_A_raw: Robust alcA/AfoA and ScpR bypass activation
interpretation_raw: Use 'cryptic under tested lab conditions,' not 'constitutively silent in nature'.

description_raw: AfoC deletion strongly reduces asperfuranone, but its exact catalytic assignment has changed between early oxidoreductase interpretations and later esterase/hydrolase annotations.
interpretation_raw: Keep functional phenotype high-confidence and catalytic mechanism moderate/uncertain.

description_raw: ScpR-dependent activation requires AfoA and a candidate shared promoter motif was identified, but direct DNA-binding biochemistry is not equivalent in strength to the genetic epistasis.
evidence_B_raw: Binding-site mechanism inferred from motif and regulatory behavior
interpretation_raw: Encode ScpR→AfoA regulation very high; encode exact direct-binding mechanism with caveat.

description_raw: Asperfuranone is antiproliferative in A549 cells, but its native role for A. nidulans is unknown.
interpretation_raw: Separate bioactivity from biological role.

description_raw: MIBiG sequence is M. pilosus, but discovery and most functional knockouts were performed in M. purpureus.
interpretation_raw: Keep organism-specific evidence layers separate; score transfer by orthology rather than relabeling experiments.

description_raw: MIBiG marks the 80-kb entry complete and contains 24 CDSs, but many have no demonstrated pigment role.
evidence_B_raw: Strong function concentrated in a subset
interpretation_raw: Preserve exact database boundary and separately encode minimal/functional programme as unresolved.

description_raw: The MIBiG GenBank locus uses numeric tags and partial letter labels, while later Monascus literature uses mpp/pig nomenclature; several one-to-one mappings are not explicitly resolved in the sources curated here.
interpretation_raw: Use exact GenBank identifiers and only assign later names where reasonably supported; avoid forced mappings.

description_raw: MIBiG lists four products for M. pilosus, while the defining paper's causal production experiments are in M. purpureus.
interpretation_raw: Score cluster/product attribution high at conserved pathway-family level but distinguish exact-strain native evidence.

description_raw: Yellow/orange branch mutants may preserve total pigment or shift red derivatives, so bulk color/total-pigment measurements can conceal mechanistic branch effects.
interpretation_raw: Record individual congeners/color classes separately whenever possible.

description_raw: MIBiG displays 46.27 kb, annotates an 18.44-kb locus and includes FFUJ_14916, whereas the experimentally characterized bik1–bik6 core is 17.09 kb.
evidence_B_raw: Functional genetics of six bik genes
interpretation_raw: Store all three levels and keep FFUJ_14916 as boundary-adjacent/uncertain.

description_raw: High nitrogen represses bik genes, but AreA is not required for this repression.
interpretation_raw: Treat nitrogen as a validated context gate while leaving the molecular sensor/regulator unresolved.

description_raw: Both regulatory genes affect product, but their transcript effects differ and Bik4 is NmrA-like rather than a standard DNA-binding TF.
interpretation_raw: Model as a regulatory subnetwork, not a single linear transcription-factor gate.

description_raw: Bik6 loss reduces export/product but does not abolish extracellular bikaverin.
interpretation_raw: Encode Bik6 as supportive transport/recovery competence rather than strictly necessary product gate.

description_raw: Ralsolamycin clearly induces bik transcription/product but the fungal receptor and intracellular signal-transduction route remain unidentified.
interpretation_raw: Strong signal-access evidence; perception/transduction mechanism remains unresolved.

description_raw: Bikaverin reduces the fraction of colonized chlamydospores, but total bacterial fluorescence burden across all spores was not significantly changed.
interpretation_raw: Support a protective contribution, not a claim of complete bacterial exclusion.

description_raw: MIBiG's compact locus feature is only the cicF PKS gene, whereas seven local genes are deletion-required and the complete chemistry likely extends beyond those seven.
evidence_B_raw: Seven-gene functional genetics + proposed extra-cluster lactamization
interpretation_raw: Maintain display, locus, local functional and full-programme boundaries as separate objects.

description_raw: The 2012 paper identifies cicG as AN11922/ANID_11922, whereas the current MIBiG-derived regional GenBank annotation at the corresponding internal position is ANIA_11509 / old AN11509.4.
interpretation_raw: Preserve cicG functional name and historical ID; flag current-coordinate mapping as annotation-reconciliation issue rather than silently replacing the identifier.

description_raw: Cichorine requires conversion from a lactone-like intermediate to the nitrogen-containing lactam, but the responsible gene(s) are absent from the deletion-defined local cluster.
interpretation_raw: Functional programme likely extends outside local cluster, but gene identity remains NF/UNCERTAIN.

description_raw: Later derivative discovery uses highly engineered dereplication or CicD-overexpression strains.
interpretation_raw: Encode derivatives as pathway-accessible chemistry without assuming equivalent native abundance.

description_raw: The defining deletion experiments were performed in a sterigmatocystin-deficient background to simplify chemistry and potentially free precursors.
interpretation_raw: Pathway necessity is strong; absolute native yields and competition effects should not be transferred without caveat.

description_raw: Cichorine and analogues are phytotoxic, but A. nidulans is not being studied here as a plant pathogen and no native ecological function is established.
interpretation_raw: Separate bioactivity from biological role.

description_raw: MlcF is an oxidoreductase in the cluster but its exact biosynthetic role remains unresolved.
interpretation_raw: Keep demonstrated_function unresolved.

description_raw: MlcE is annotated as an efflux pump and fits a self-resistance model, but direct compactin transport kinetics were not curated.
interpretation_raw: Use predicted efflux/self-resistance wording.

description_raw: Compactin's mammalian HMGCR pharmacology does not establish why P. citrinum makes it.
interpretation_raw: Keep native role unresolved.

description_raw: MIBiG/GenBank contains eight CDSs, but direct chemical sufficiency is established for only two PKSs.
interpretation_raw: Store exact database boundary separately from minimal biosynthetic core; keep CurR/CurE as plausible native-support genes.

description_raw: CurR is strongly plausible as a pathway-specific regulator but was not directly perturbed in the defining study.
interpretation_raw: Do not assign direct activation causality beyond prediction.

description_raw: CurE is annotated as an exporter, but CurE-free yeast still releases recoverable DHC.
interpretation_raw: Host substitution prevents concluding CurE is dispensable in native A. terreus.

description_raw: The source strain naturally produces DHC, but the native environmental, developmental and transcriptional induction programme was not characterized in the cluster paper.
interpretation_raw: Do not infer regulatory access conditions from the heterologous yeast system.

description_raw: A. terreus NIH2624 does not carry the producer-strain PKS pair.
interpretation_raw: Represent BGC presence at strain level, not as universal A. terreus genotype.

description_raw: 11-hydroxycurvularin is a major product in yeast dual-PKS reconstruction but may arise partly by hydration of dehydrocurvularin rather than as an independently programmed native pathway endpoint.
interpretation_raw: Store as derivative/co-product, not a separate required BGC target.

description_raw: MIBiG marks all six genes within a complete cluster, but only DEP2, DEP4, DEP5 and DEP6 were directly demonstrated by targeted disruption in the defining study.
interpretation_raw: Retain DEP1/DEP3 as cluster members with lower gene-level functional confidence.

description_raw: DEP1 is coregulated with the pathway but has no resolved biochemical function.
interpretation_raw: Keep as functional-programme member without assigning an enzymatic reaction.

description_raw: DEP3 is predicted as an MFS transporter, but direct A. brassicicola knockout evidence is absent in the defining paper and broader evolution suggests possible functions beyond depudecin transport.
interpretation_raw: Score transport assignment moderate and avoid treating it as an obligatory export gate.

description_raw: DEP2 and DEP4 are both required and mutants accumulate epoxide-containing compounds, but precise reaction order and structures are incompletely resolved.
interpretation_raw: Encode both as oxidative competence gates without inventing a linear order.

description_raw: Depudecin loss reduces cabbage virulence only modestly and has no significant Arabidopsis phenotype.
interpretation_raw: Classify as host-dependent minor virulence factor, not a universal pathogenicity determinant.

description_raw: Temperature and nitrogen regime alter depudecin production, but the signaling/transcriptional mechanism connecting these inputs to DEP6 remains unknown.
interpretation_raw: Record environmental state dependence separately from mechanistic activation pathway.

description_raw: 5-AZA, SAHA and SBHA did not alter metabolite profiles in one liquid-culture study.
interpretation_raw: Store as tested-condition negative, not proof chromatin regulation is irrelevant to DEP expression.

description_raw: MIBiG presents a single 52.8-kb pksA-centered record although the biosynthetic programme is physically fragmented across six chromosome-12 loci.
interpretation_raw: Store BGC0000048 as a mini-cluster and encode full functional programme separately.

description_raw: DQ149246 uses moxA/cypA labels, while genome-level pathway literature uses MoxY/CypX-like aflatoxin-homolog nomenclature.
interpretation_raw: Do not collapse names automatically; preserve accession-specific labels and document orthology separately.

description_raw: Later literature refers to 20 known genes across six chromosome-12 loci, while individual publications use somewhat different historical mini-cluster gene sets/names.
interpretation_raw: Treat count as programme-level literature statement and retain individual gene provenance.

description_raw: Chromosome-11 NorB is strongly AflR-responsive and pathway-homologous, but direct metabolite knockout evidence is lacking.
evidence_B_raw: No direct NorB loss-of-function product test encoded here
interpretation_raw: Mark as high-confidence candidate, not confirmed required gene.

description_raw: LaeA deletion increases dothistromin, contrary to common positive LaeA effects in Aspergillus aflatoxin/ST pathways.
interpretation_raw: Use source-strain evidence; do not transfer regulator sign across species.

description_raw: Earlier work described dothistromin as 'not required' for disease because mutants still infected and completed the life cycle; later detailed phenotyping showed reduced lesion expansion and sporulation.
interpretation_raw: No contradiction once pathogenicity (ability to cause disease) is separated from virulence (severity/fitness within disease).

description_raw: DotC is an MFS transporter in a dothistromin mini-cluster, but functional assays were inconclusive for direct toxin efflux.
interpretation_raw: Keep transport role uncertain rather than promoting annotation to demonstrated mechanism.

description_raw: Some isolates with high dothistromin phenotypes show chromosome duplications, but the relevant chromosomes and causal contribution vary.
interpretation_raw: Store as context/copy-number association only.

description_raw: MIBiG's partial locus contains ten genes and broad flanks, but local product causality collapses to OrsA for OA and OrsA–C for F9775A/B.
interpretation_raw: Maintain database, transcriptional and functional boundaries separately.

description_raw: cclA loss and bacterial contact induce neighboring genes that targeted deletion shows are unnecessary for the assigned products.
interpretation_raw: Do not promote co-expression to functional membership without causal evidence.

description_raw: The structural complexity of F9775A/B suggests additional post-PKS functions may act outside OrsA–C, but they were not identified in the defining local screen.
interpretation_raw: Mark local core as necessary while keeping whole-programme completeness partial.

description_raw: Direct physical contact is necessary for the S. rapamycinicus route, but the proximal bacterial ligand/fungal receptor is not identified.
interpretation_raw: Strong signal-delivery evidence; perception/transduction remains unresolved.

description_raw: H3K9 acetylation tracks productive states and GcnE is necessary in key contexts, but acetylation alone does not guarantee transcription.
evidence_B_raw: Acetylation without full transcription in some backgrounds
interpretation_raw: Encode chromatin competence as one gate, not a sufficient endpoint.

description_raw: The cluster was historically called cryptic/silent, yet stationary Czapek alone allows wild-type production.
evidence_A_raw: No product in common lab regimes
interpretation_raw: Use condition-resolved transcription/product states instead of global 'silent' label.

description_raw: The 2009 inducer was historically reported as Streptomyces hygroscopicus and later referred to as S. rapamycinicus.
interpretation_raw: Preserve synonym/history so identical interaction is not split into two inducer entities.

description_raw: All 16 genes lie in the FUM cluster, but several are not biosynthetic enzymes in the narrow sense.
interpretation_raw: Use functional classes within the cluster rather than one undifferentiated 'biosynthetic gene' label.

description_raw: Fum19 is an ABC transporter, but extracellular FB1 increases when it is deleted.
interpretation_raw: Do not infer direct export from annotation; primary demonstrated role is negative feedback/regulation.

description_raw: Fum17 is ceramide-synthase-like but cannot fully substitute as a standalone CerS in yeast; function improves with Cer3 coexpression.
interpretation_raw: Score self-protection role below Fum18 and avoid equating the paralogs.

description_raw: Older FUM16 deletion showed no obvious fumonisin-production defect; modern biochemical work identifies palmitoyl-CoA ligase/self-protection function.
interpretation_raw: Complementary, not conflicting: FUM16 is nonessential for canonical product formation but relevant to protection physiology.

description_raw: Historical literature used meiotic Fum3 and cloned-gene FUM9 nomenclature before modern annotation consolidated the C5 hydroxylase as FUM3.
interpretation_raw: Preserve aliases/history to prevent duplicate-gene entities.

description_raw: Fumonisin contribution to maize disease is context dependent: FUM1-null strains retained ear infection/ear-rot ability in field trials, while a distinct seedling study found fumonisin production associated with foliar disease symptoms and restored pathogenicity after whole-cluster complementation of a nonproducing banana isolate.
evidence_A_raw: Field ear assays: toxin-null strains remain pathogenic (S004).
evidence_B_raw: Seedling foliar assays: producing/complemented strains cause symptoms whereas nonproducers do not (S022).
interpretation_raw: Do not label fumonisin simply essential or dispensable for virulence; encode host tissue, disease stage and assay architecture.

description_raw: HDAC perturbation changes FUM genes unequally.
interpretation_raw: Do not use a single chromatin proxy as evidence that every FUM gene is equivalently accessible.

description_raw: Numerous environmental/global regulators affect fumonisins, but the precise upstream logic connecting maize/nutrition to Fum21 and Fum19 feedback remains distributed across many studies.
interpretation_raw: Represent inputs and demonstrated regulatory nodes separately rather than forcing a linear activation pathway.

description_raw: Recent sources call NRRL39464/FRC O-1890 both CAR1 and CAR2 in different data products.
interpretation_raw: Use NRRL39464/FRC O-1890 as stable identifiers; preserve CAR alias conflict rather than choosing one.

description_raw: MIBiG labels the producer F. oxysporum, but the modern FOSC contains deep lineages that can merit narrower species treatment.
interpretation_raw: Retain F. oxysporum for record identity while treating strain as the reliable unit.

description_raw: CPM1 is a cluster-adjacent P450 and has co-evolved with the FUM locus in some Fusarium lineages, but chemical function is untested.
interpretation_raw: Do not assign hydroxy-FC1 formation to CPM1.

description_raw: Hydroxy-FC1 requires an additional hydroxylation whose responsible gene remains unknown.
interpretation_raw: Leave enzymatic attribution unresolved.

description_raw: Most O-1890 FUM genes have strong functional assignments by conservation with F. verticillioides, but only FUM8 and FUM15 receive especially direct O-1890-specific functional tests in the sources curated here.
